verified_facts: Atossa's 2026-10-08 CVR agreement was publicly filed 2026-10-09.
One CVR is attached to each eligible common share; while attached it transfers only with the share, has no separate CUSIP and no separate trading market.
The right is contingent on the first qualifying FDA priority review voucher; holders collectively receive 25% of net monetization proceeds subject to a USD 50m aggregate cap.
Detachment is discretionary; detached rights may never obtain a trading market.
At filing, no qualifying voucher had been awarded and no marketing application for the referenced program had been submitted.
evidence_assessment.event_clock: PASS_FOR_THIS_ISSUER: SEC filing timestamp and later first-public primary documents can define state transitions point-in-time.
evidence_assessment.legacy_distinctness: PASS_BOUNDED: independent repository search found no pre-existing stapled-CVR candidate; the mechanism is causally distinct from the due-bill large-distribution candidate.
evidence_assessment.population_generalizability: FAIL_CURRENTLY_UNPROVEN: independent search established the Atossa instance but did not establish a defensible multi-event population of US-listed continuing common equity with initially non-tradable stapled CVRs under comparable contracts.
evidence_assessment.contract_comparability: BLOCKED_PENDING_POPULATION: issuer-specific discretion over detachment, qualifying program, monetization, dilution before detachment, payment constraints and outside date can dominate any cross-event state definition.
evidence_assessment.implementability: DOCUMENTARY_ONLY; instrument identity is auditable while attached, but no economic/transaction-cost conclusion is authorized.

cross_examination.strongest_surviving_claim: The Atossa common share temporarily bundles operating equity with a legally attached contingent contractual claim whose state is auditable from primary documents.
claims_not_supported: that stapled-CVR state transitions form a repeatable event class
that any transition creates a valuation dislocation
that the contingent right is economically material
cross_examination.active_invalidation: The frozen hypothesis itself requires a defensible multi-event population before outcome access. That requirement is not presently met; therefore the mechanism cannot advance to economic test design without violating its own falsification scope.

red_team.reason: Primary-document validity of the single Atossa case is not enough to establish the required comparable event population. Advancing to outcomes now would convert an issuer-specific curiosity into an economic look before the frozen population criterion is satisfied.

claim_restriction: Retain only the documentary statement that EVENT-STAPLED-CVR-PRV-001 is a real, auditable issuer-specific bundled-claim structure. Do not claim a repeatable mechanism, valuation effect or edge. Reopen only after a pre-outcome, primary-document inventory establishes a defensible multi-event population and ex-ante comparable state taxonomy.
